name: local-image-gen
description: Generate images on your own machine — no cloud, no API key. Runs through a local ComfyUI server, so no prompt or pixel leaves the host. Bind a locally-installed checkpoint to the Image Generation use case in Models. Weights are user-pulled: this app ships code only and downloads nothing. Recommended permissive default: FLUX.1-schnell (Apache-2.0).
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: ComfyUI endpoint
x-meta.help: Where your local ComfyUI server listens. Must be a loopback or private-network address — a public host is refused, because this backend exists to keep generation on your own machine.

x-meta.label: Sampling steps
x-meta.help: Denoising steps per image. FLUX.1-schnell is distilled for 1-4 steps; raise it only for a model that needs more.
